_help._file: How long the AI seems to think, so players can follow what it did. The real thinking is quick (timeBudgetMs); the rest is a pause for people.
_help.thinkSeconds.draft.min: Shortest pause before it places a glyphling in the draft, in seconds (at Normal speed). Try 0.4–1.
_help.thinkSeconds.draft.max: Longest pause before it places a glyphling. Each pause is picked between min and max. Try 0.8–1.6.
_help.thinkSeconds.moveCast.min: Shortest pause before its move + cast, in seconds (at Normal speed). Try 0.5–1.2.
_help.thinkSeconds.moveCast.max: Longest pause before its move + cast. Try 1–2.
_help.thinkSeconds.refresh.min: Shortest pause before it refreshes seeds, in seconds. Try 0.3–0.8.
_help.thinkSeconds.refresh.max: Longest pause before it refreshes seeds. Try 0.6–1.2.
_help.thinkSeconds.aim.min: After its glide, the AI holds its aim (the seed sits on its target, the words light up) before it throws — like a person looking at their aim before Cast. Shortest hold, in seconds (at Normal speed). 0 = it throws the moment the glide ends. Try 0.2–0.6.
_help.thinkSeconds.aim.max: Longest hold on its aim before the throw. Try 0.4–1.
_help.speeds.slow: Settings → AI speed: Slow. Pauses are divided by this (0.5 = twice as long).
_help.speeds.normal: Settings → AI speed: Normal (1 = the pauses above as they are).
_help.speeds.fast: Settings → AI speed: Fast (2 = half as long).
_help.speeds.instant: Settings → AI speed: Instant. 0 = no pause at all (the moves still animate).
_help.timeBudgetMs: The most time one decision may take on a phone, in milliseconds. The skill's candidate count is chosen to fit inside it.
_help.serverBudgetMs: Online: the most time one decision may take in the room on the server, in milliseconds (the room waits while it thinks). npm run ai:server-timing checks every skill against it. The online AI's pauses are the Normal-speed ones above.

_labels.thinkSeconds.aim.min: Aim: shortest hold before the throw (s)
_labels.thinkSeconds.aim.max: Aim: longest hold before the throw (s)
_labels.timeBudgetMs: Thinking budget per decision on a phone (ms)
_labels.serverBudgetMs: Thinking budget per decision online, on the server (ms)
